title: archiphyllum macrophyllum
intro: Archiphyllum macrophyllum, commonly known as Western Sword Fern, is a plant species native to the Pacific Northwest region of North America. This evergreen fern is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to support respiratory health and act as an expectorant, making it beneficial for relieving coughs and congestion. The Western Sword Fern contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The plant's therapeutic actions also suggest its potential use in supporting skin health and wound healing, although more research is necessary to confirm its efficacy in these areas.
